**Reference images to trace over**

Pictures can be laid over or under the 2D map to trace over, as WorldPainter's overlay (Edit ▸ Add Reference Image…, or drop a PNG or JPEG on the map). Each is moved, scaled and turned with handles on the map or typed in (its middle, blocks a pixel, rotation), faded, shown or hidden, locked, and set over the map or under it, the map then faded over it. There can be several; they are saved with the map, found again beside it when moved with it, and never exported. A large picture stays smooth at any zoom: it is kept on the graphics card with mipmaps.
